user_intent: 期望 声音 处于 61 dB 到 68 dB
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 68 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_low() xiaomi_television
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 61 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_high() xiaomi_television
IF viomi_hood.reading() >= 0.17 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
